payload.title: File:Gondwanacanthus decollatus MCP3458A anterior region.jpg
payload.artist_html: Alexandre Cunha Ribeiro, Diogo de Mayrinck, Flávio Alicino Bockmann and Mário de Pinna
payload.description_html: †Gondwanacanthus decollatus sp. nov., paratype specimen MCP3458A. A, detail of the anterior region showing remains of the opercular, suspensorium, and pectoral fin elements. B, interpretative illustration. Abbreviations: Cl, cleithrum; Cor, coracoid; Hm, hyomandibular; M.cor, mesocoracoid; Op, opercle; Pop, preopercle; Sca, scapula; Scaf, scapular foramen; Scl, supracleithrum. Scale bars represent 10 mm.
